dataset.name: deterministic synthetic mixed-category merchant catalog (furniture + apparel + automotive)

repetitions: 5 independent full runs; correctness/routing/schema-diagnostic numbers are deterministic byte-for-byte -- only latency varies run-to-run

headline_result.schema_management_diagnostic: 18 product types + 15 brands discovered purely from the ingested Catalog (SynthProduct::family never read by ingest::build_catalog or commerce_core, confirmed by grep); CatalogIndex::build bitmap-indexes every Enum/MultiEnum/Boolean value and sorts Numeric values purely by AttributeValue's own variant tag, no per-family conditional anywhere
headline_result.size_schema_conflict_recall_gap: lexicon.resolve("34") returns exactly 1 candidate (apparel-only) -- automotive's Numeric size never reaches the lexicon at all; measured consequence: size_schema_conflict queries return 0/64 (0.0%) apparel-side recall vs 10/10 (100%) automotive-side recall, reproduced identically across 5 runs -- safe (Constraint::matches's `_ => false` prevents any false positive) but a real, disclosed recall gap, filed as a scoped design question per the P9-E05 precedent
headline_result.residual_lexical_veto_finding: residual_veto_probe mean NDCG@10 = 0.3333 (n=3): 'furniture sofas'/'automotive brake pads' both score 0 because their residual word matches zero indexed titles, so execute_planned's Hybrid/Punt outcomes return nothing even though the ProductType structural constraint alone identifies hundreds of correct candidates; 'apparel sneakers' scores 1.0 only via an unrelated brand-name coincidence ('Cascade Apparel'). same_catalog_control (bare product-type phrase, confound removed) scores a clean mean NDCG@10 = 1.0000 (n=3, all FastPath). Reproduced identically across 5 runs. Filed as a scoped design question, not patched here.
headline_result.cross_category_bare_attribute: mean NDCG@10 = 1.0000 (n=3, all Punt) -- bare shared-attribute queries (color, 'leather black') correctly span every matching family with no hidden single-family bias
